description: Makes guarded local mail, calendar, and task tools discoverable from natural-language requests.

defaultPrompt: Check all my inboxes and summarize what needs attention.
Show my open tasks across configured accounts.
interface.longDescription: For local Codex sessions, recognizes inbox, email, calendar, schedule, meeting, reminder, and task requests and routes them to the guarded local Corresync MCP server. Hosted ChatGPT cannot reach this local stdio integration.
interface.shortDescription: Use guarded local mail, calendar, and task tools

name: corresync
